Outcome_variable.evidence_source: [/page/1/Text/10] The aim of the current study was to identify and link interacting patterns of positive and negative affect to academic success during the transition to adulthood.

sample_type.evidence_source: [/page/1/Text/11] We accomplished our aim statistically by examining how different combinations of within-person reports (time-limited bouts or states) and between-person reports (individual differences or traits) of affect were associated with academic success across 4 years of university.
